audit_title: Depth Anything V2 Relative Surface Orientation Audit
sensor_spatial_relation: In aerial nadir imaging, surface features with higher elevation (e.g. building rooftops, canopies) are closer to the optical sensor than ground plane features.
raw_orientation: Larger raw depth values correspond to features closer to the camera.
elevation_alignment: Because closer to sensor = higher elevation in overhead viewing, larger raw values naturally align with increasing surface height.
conflation_prevention: Decoupled from metric AGL (metres) and Absolute DSM (metres). No metres are displayed for Relative Surface.
